programs.description: Cousins Rashi and Gopi were raised in the same house, but Gopi was left illiterate and shy, in contrast to Rashi being educated and outgoing. When the two cousins marry into the same family, they set out on a journey in search of acceptance.

In the vibrant and bustling landscape of Somnath, a self-owned grocery store serves as the lifeblood of a quintessential Gujarati joint family. Across generations, it stands witness to the ebbs and flows of their journey.
A young woman is forced to marry a local man. Although she falls in love with him eventually, she continues protesting against the male domination at her in-laws' place.
Sailee dreams of marrying her prince charming. However, destiny brings her Sachin, a complex figure.
